limitations: Independent AI visual/structural review only, not representative-user research or a human-usability claim. All 16 neutral and 32 authored files were opened with actual image viewing. No condition/model attribution was attempted.

Neutral observations were frozen in r1-a-neutral.md before authored.json/images were opened. Neutral grayscale, removed radius/shadow and replaced font are diagnostic and can reflow content; original authorship styling is assessed only after the freeze.

All neutral captures are full-page. Authored -03/-04/-05 are actual 1440×1000 or 390×844 viewports; product -06 is full-page, while transfer -06 is an actual failure-state viewport. Below-fold content in a full-page image is never treated as initially visible.

Screenshots cannot prove working controls, accessible selection semantics, keyboard or assistive-technology behavior, focus handling, validation, input retention, recalculation, unavailable-stock prevention, actual cart/transfer success, contrast certification or real transactional safety.

Product cart-labeled viewport captures show page-top content rather than visible confirmation; a-02 shows Sand label at the lower edge, while a-01/a-05/a-07 are visibly unchanged at the top. No conclusion about presence or absence of offscreen confirmation or task success follows.

Uniform capture-scope clarification supplied after initial authored inspection: every state screenshot explicitly scrolls to page top before capture, including review/cart/failure. These are top-of-page state viewports, not natural post-click scroll/focus landings. Offscreen feedback or controls do not establish broken behavior, poor focus/scroll management, or absence elsewhere. Neutral notes are unchanged; authored recovery interpretation was adjusted explicitly for a-03.

a-03 failure visibly explains failure but not retry in its top-of-page viewport; recovery is null. a-06 visibly shows failure, recipient/amount, Try again and Edit, allowing assessment of that visible presentation only. a-04/a-08 failure-labeled viewports show only ledger content, so recovery is null there. No success or invalid-amount state is provided for any transfer view.
Transfer review images use USD375 and failure images USD400. These distinct snapshots support assessment of visible arithmetic and labels, not proof of an exact input-retention or edit sequence.

Scores are separate 1–5 judgments within shown scope (1 weak/blocking, 3 usable with material issues, 5 consistently strong); null means unassessed. No total slop/quality score is supplied. Familiar form/card/product structures are judged by task purpose, not penalized for familiarity.

Access was limited to packet README, task briefs/fixtures, neutral/authored inventories and their images. No private maps, creator code/notes, test results, manifest, other runs or other reviewers were inspected. Only this review JSON and frozen neutral notes were written.
